rationale: C17 plausibly supplied a material structural template: both orders establish a named presidential/interdepartmental committee, define its composition, assign it duties involving examination or improvement of agency practices, authorize recommendations to executive bodies, and require government-wide implementation or cooperation. The subject matter differs, and the language is not closely copied, but the shared sequence and committee machinery are concrete enough to support reuse. C02 has weaker parallels in interagency coordination, investigation, reporting, and recommendations; C18 contains only a generic agency-cooperation provision.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There shall be created in the national Military Establishment an advisory committee to be known as the President's Committee on Equality of Treatment and Opportunity in the Armed Services
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established the Interdepartmental Committee for the Peacetime Voluntary Payroll Savings Plan for the Purchase of United States Savings Bonds
shared_material.explanation: Both directives begin their operative machinery by establishing and naming a committee devoted to implementing a presidential policy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Committee is authorized on behalf of the President to examine into the rules, procedures and practices of the armed services ... and shall make such recommendations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Committee shall perform the following functions and duties ... Recommend to the several departments, establishments, and agencies, any methods for improvements
shared_material.explanation: Each committee is charged with reviewing or improving administrative practices and making recommendations to relevant executive organizations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Committee in its work
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Each of the departments, establishments, and agencies in the executive branch of the Government shall institute and set in operation ... the plan ... recommended by the Committee
shared_material.explanation: Both orders couple committee recommendations with an operative government-wide agency obligation, although the child's cooperation mandate is broader and less prescriptive.
